text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Real dynamos have not one knob, but a panel. How hard the metal is stirred; how well it conducts. What the discs are made of: remember the iron. How unequal their speeds are: that is when V K S flipped. For Dress-dine, a pree-sessing tank: how fast its axis turns.
